sentences.pt: Camila tinha terminado a faculdade em dezembro e procurava o primeiro emprego como engenheira.
sentences.en: Camila had finished university in December and was looking for her first job as an engineer.

sentences.pt: Durante dois meses, ela enviou o currículo para mais de trinta empresas.
sentences.en: For two months, she sent her résumé to more than thirty companies.

sentences.pt: Quase ninguém respondeu, e ela começou a perder a esperança.
sentences.en: Almost no one answered, and she started to lose hope.

sentences.pt: Um dia, porém, recebeu um e-mail de uma empresa de energia solar em Curitiba.
sentences.en: One day, however, she received an email from a solar energy company in Curitiba.

sentences.pt: Eles queriam fazer uma entrevista com ela na sexta-feira, às nove da manhã.
sentences.en: They wanted to do an interview with her on Friday, at nine in the morning.

sentences.pt: Camila ficou feliz, mas também muito nervosa.
sentences.en: Camila was happy, but also very nervous.

sentences.pt: Na véspera, ela leu tudo sobre a empresa e ensaiou as respostas com a mãe.
sentences.en: The day before, she read everything about the company and rehearsed her answers with her mother.

sentences.pt: Na sexta-feira, embora estivesse com medo do trânsito, saiu de casa bem cedo.
sentences.en: On Friday, although she was afraid of the traffic, she left home very early.

sentences.pt: No entanto, o ônibus quebrou no meio da avenida.
sentences.en: However, the bus broke down in the middle of the avenue.

sentences.pt: Os passageiros tiveram que descer e esperar outro ônibus.
sentences.en: The passengers had to get off and wait for another bus.

sentences.pt: Camila olhou o relógio: eram oito e quarenta.
sentences.en: Camila looked at her watch: it was eight forty.

sentences.pt: Ela ligou para a empresa e explicou o problema à secretária.
sentences.en: She called the company and explained the problem to the secretary.

sentences.pt: A secretária disse que não era um problema e que o chefe podia esperar meia hora.
sentences.en: The secretary said it wasn't a problem and that the boss could wait half an hour.

sentences.pt: Mesmo assim, Camila decidiu pegar um táxi para não chegar muito atrasada.
sentences.en: Even so, Camila decided to take a taxi so as not to arrive very late.

sentences.pt: Chegou às nove e dez, cansada e com o rosto vermelho.
sentences.en: She arrived at ten past nine, tired and with a red face.

sentences.pt: O chefe, um senhor simpático chamado Ricardo, pediu que ela se sentasse e tomasse um café.
sentences.en: The boss, a friendly man named Ricardo, asked her to sit down and have a coffee.

sentences.pt: Ele perguntou sobre o estágio que ela tinha feito e sobre os projetos da faculdade.
sentences.en: He asked about the internship she had done and about her university projects.

sentences.pt: Camila respondeu com calma, apesar do estresse da manhã.
sentences.en: Camila answered calmly, despite the morning's stress.

sentences.pt: No fim, Ricardo disse que gostava de pessoas que resolvem problemas sozinhas.
sentences.en: At the end, Ricardo said that he liked people who solve problems on their own.

sentences.pt: "Você não desistiu quando o ônibus quebrou; isso é o que a gente precisa", explicou.
sentences.en: "You didn't give up when the bus broke down; that's what we need," he explained.

sentences.pt: Duas semanas depois, Camila assinou o contrato.
sentences.en: Two weeks later, Camila signed the contract.

sentences.pt: Hoje ela trabalha no departamento de projetos e sempre sai de casa uma hora antes.
sentences.en: Today she works in the projects department and always leaves home an hour early.

questions.q: Onde fica a empresa que chamou Camila?
questions.qEn: Where is the company that called Camila?

questions.q: O que Ricardo gostou em Camila?
questions.qEn: What did Ricardo like about Camila?

sentences.pt: Na universidade, o professor Eduardo pediu que a turma fizesse um trabalho em equipe sobre reciclagem.
sentences.en: At university, Professor Eduardo asked the class to do a team project on recycling.

sentences.pt: O prazo era curto: cada equipe teria apenas três semanas para entregar a pesquisa e dar uma palestra para a turma.
sentences.en: The deadline was short: each team would have only three weeks to hand in the research and give a talk to the class.

sentences.pt: Diego, Letícia, Bruno e Aline formaram uma equipe, embora não se conhecessem bem.
sentences.en: Diego, Letícia, Bruno and Aline formed a team, although they didn't know each other well.

sentences.pt: Na primeira reunião, eles dividiram as tarefas e fizeram um cronograma numa planilha.
sentences.en: At the first meeting, they divided up the tasks and made a schedule in a spreadsheet.

sentences.pt: Letícia ficou responsável pelos dados, Diego pela redação e Aline pelos gráficos.
sentences.en: Letícia was in charge of the data, Diego the writing and Aline the charts.

sentences.pt: Bruno, que trabalhava à noite num restaurante, disse que faria a palestra.
sentences.en: Bruno, who worked at night in a restaurant, said he would give the talk.

sentences.pt: Durante a primeira semana, tudo correu bem.
sentences.en: During the first week, everything went well.

sentences.pt: Na segunda semana, no entanto, Bruno parou de responder às mensagens da equipe.
sentences.en: In the second week, however, Bruno stopped answering the team's messages.

sentences.pt: Diego ficou irritado e queria contar tudo ao professor.
sentences.en: Diego got annoyed and wanted to tell the professor everything.

sentences.pt: "Talvez ele esteja com algum problema", disse Aline.
sentences.en: "Maybe he's having some problem," said Aline.

sentences.pt: "Antes de reclamar, a gente devia conversar com ele."
sentences.en: "Before complaining, we should talk to him."

sentences.pt: Então Letícia ligou para Bruno muitas vezes, e ele por fim respondeu.
sentences.en: So Letícia called Bruno many times, and he finally answered.

sentences.pt: Ele explicou que o pai tinha ficado doente e que estava fazendo horas extras para pagar o hospital.
sentences.en: He explained that his father had gotten sick and that he was working overtime to pay the hospital.

sentences.pt: Ele estava envergonhado e não sabia como dizer isso aos colegas.
sentences.en: He was embarrassed and didn't know how to tell his classmates.

sentences.pt: A equipe decidiu ajudar: cada um falaria um pouco na palestra.
sentences.en: The team decided to help: each one would speak a little in the talk.

sentences.pt: Bruno, por outro lado, faria os gráficos no celular, durante o almoço no restaurante.
sentences.en: Bruno, on the other hand, would do the charts on his phone, during lunch at the restaurant.

sentences.pt: No dia da palestra, os quatro falaram com segurança e responderam a todas as perguntas.
sentences.en: On the day of the talk, the four spoke confidently and answered all the questions.

sentences.pt: O professor gostou muito do trabalho e deu nota nove à equipe.
sentences.en: The professor really liked the work and gave the team a grade of nine.

sentences.pt: Depois da aula, eles foram a um restaurante perto da universidade para jantar.
sentences.en: After class, they went to a restaurant near the university for dinner.

sentences.pt: Bruno contou que o pai já estava melhor e disse "muito obrigado" aos colegas.
sentences.en: Bruno said his father was already better and said "thank you very much" to his classmates.

sentences.pt: Desde então, os quatro estudam sempre na casa de Aline antes das provas.
sentences.en: Since then, the four always study at Aline's house before exams.

questions.q: Sobre o que era o trabalho?
Por que Bruno parou de responder?

questions.qEn: What grade did the team get?
